title: Affiliate Disclosure
content:
Affiliate Disclosure

Grimdark Builds is reader-supported. Some links on this site are affiliate links: if you click through and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

We only recommend products we would (and do) recommend to a friend starting the hobby. Affiliate commissions never influence our verdicts — beginners get the same honest advice whether a link earns a commission or not.

Grimdark Builds is an unofficial fan site. Warhammer 40,000 is a trademark of Games Workshop. This site is not affiliated with or endorsed by Games Workshop.
